title: Breece Hall believes 2026 'could be my best season' following Jets' offseason additions

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Breece Hall believes 2026 'could be my best season' following Jets' offseason additions
sources.description: Jets running back Breece Hall officially signed his new three-year, $45.75 million contract on Tuesday, ensuring that he will be a key piece of the New York offense for years to come.
